name: Boku to Oku-san no Hatsujou Koubi Nikki ~Katei Kyoushi wa Tonari no Bijin Tsuma~
original_name: ボクと奥さんの発情交尾日記～家庭教師は隣の美人妻～
source:
Even though I attended a prestigious high school, I wasn’t exactly a top student, and every day felt like a drag.

My only solace was the girl who rode the same train as me every day.
She was refreshing and pure—just looking at her cleansed my soul… or so I thought.

But then I saw it.
I saw her having sex with a guy in a back alley.
The girl I’d idolized, covered in semen, laughing sloppily as she kept climaxing—.

Shocked, I was running later than usual on my way home.
Someone called out to me at my apartment building. When I turned around and saw her face, I nearly fainted.

“You’re Mr. Saegusa’s son from next door… right? Please, keep what happened this morning a secret? I’ll do anything…”

translation:
尽管就读于名门高中，我的成绩却实在算不上拔尖，每天都过得百无聊赖。

我唯一的慰藉，便是每天与我搭乘同一班电车的那位女性。
她气质清新纯洁，光是远远看着她便仿佛能涤荡心灵……至少我原本是这么以为的。

直到我亲眼撞见了那一幕——
我在僻静的后巷里看见她正和一个男人激烈交合。
一直被我奉若女神的她浑身沾满精液，脸上挂着淫荡松弛的笑容高潮连连——

大受冲击的我比平时晚了一些才赶回家。
走到公寓楼下时，身后突然有人叫住了我。回头看清对方脸庞的瞬间，我险些当场晕倒。

“你是隔壁三枝先生家的儿子……对吧？拜托你，今天早上的事能替我保密吗？让我做什么都可以……”
